summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary pricing supplement (424B5) for a new issue of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due August 2, 2032. The notes are linked to the worst-performing of the Russell 2000 Index and the EURO STOXX 50 Index, with an aggregate principal amount yet to be set, issue price of $1,000 per note, and quarterly contingent coupon payments. The notes are autocallable quarterly starting July 2027 and include a barrier feature at maturity. This is a routine structured note offering under an existing shelf registration, not a special-situation event. No deal terms are applicable.
